summary: The reversed code matches the decompilation, but the independent P-code shows the branches are reversed.
issues: The P-code branches to the subtraction at 0x006d6c00 when param_1 == 0; the reversed code writes zero in that case.
When param_1 != 0, the P-code writes zero at 0x006d6bfb; the reversed code performs the subtraction.
fix_instructions: Swap the branch bodies: assign param_1 minus the 32-bit this address when param_1 == 0, and assign zero otherwise.
